permissions.description: See delivery zones and their postal codes, test a postal code, and read the out-of-zone demand report
Create and edit delivery zones, map postal codes to them, and import a postal-code file
See the store's identity — its name, tagline, logo text, address, status, currency, timezone and custom-domain claim
Change the store's name, brand and settings, claim a custom domain, and publish or unpublish the store — the act that makes it visible to anyone

role_templates.description: Runs the store: its published identity and its delivery map. Built from the Storefront catalogue alone — publishing a store is not the same job as owning the account.
role_templates.name: Storefront administrator

role_templates.description: Every person with a Storefront seat. Reads the store's settings and its delivery zones, including which postal codes were turned away, and changes neither.
role_templates.name: Storefront staff
